pitchNote: Heuristic layer only: paraphrased instruction files and re-implemented duplicate source pairs sit in the borderline band (>4KB for instructions, tiny for source) so none flip atRisk on their own. Use --mode hybrid with a real LLM backend to see whether redundant_instructions / semantic_bloat findings catch paraphrased (not just literal) duplication (manual, non-deterministic — see docs/E2E_HYBRID_SCAN_TEST.md).
schemaNote: savedPercent is CLI display math only. The v0 scan-report.json contract stores beforeTokens, afterTokens, and savedTokens.
